text:
HARD CORRECTION — the keystone render is NOT proven. The user put eyes on it and it fails. Straight facts from their screen:

- `tools/rjit game play` (no flags) renders a flat 2D UI — two colored rectangles — every time. User verbatim: "i dont even understand why we are rendering 2d in the first place. im beyond confused what they want me to check when its a 2d ui each time."
- WHY it's 2D: world_loader.zig's DEFAULT draw path is 2D tile-grid rects (framework/gpu/rects.zig). The 3D Scene3D path EXISTS but is gated behind `--3d` and renders ONE HARDCODED CUBE (world_loader.zig:206-213) — not the world. So "Stage 1 3D landed" was a cube behind a flag, disconnected from what `play` actually draws. That overclaim is the problem.
- The bake under-produces: the "constructed 360x360 map" renders as ~2 cells because bakeGameFile.ts emits a near-empty tile grid, NOT the real hmsc world geometry (buildings/roads/props).
- The "render proof GREEN" only checked PNG-exists + no-V8. It NEVER checked the pixels are the world. Green-at-the-wrong-layer. Not accepted again.

FIX — render the user's REAL WORLD in 3D, by default, from baked data. Three parts, all required:

1. 3D BY DEFAULT. Make `tools/rjit game play` with NO flags render in 3D via gpu/3d.zig. Drop the 2D rects path as the default and drop the `--3d` gate. There is no reason to ever show a 2D tile grid.

2. REAL GEOMETRY FROM THE BAKE. Populate the Scene3D tree from the CONSTRUCTED WORLD'S geometry — every building/tile/prop as a Scene3D.Mesh instance — NOT one hardcoded cube. bakeGameFile.ts must serialize the real hmsc world's 3D geometry into the game-file so the loader has real meshes to place. If the world is a tile map today, extrude tiles into 3D blocks at their real positions/heights so the user sees their actual map as 3D geometry — MANY instances, not 2.

3. KILL THE SILENT FIXTURE FALLBACK (cli/commands/game.ts resolveGameFile ~line 452). A failed bake must FAIL LOUDLY, never silently load the test fixture. And the headless proof must assert on REAL GEOMETRY — mesh/instance count matching the world's content, multiple distinct transforms — and FAIL if it draws <= a handful of placeholder quads/cubes. No more PNG-exists proofs.

THE BAR: ONLY the user running `tools/rjit game play` (no flags) and seeing their actual 3D world counts as done. Do NOT report GREEN from a self-check. When you believe it is ready, tell me exactly what the user should run and what they should see; I relay, the user verifies.

FIRST: commit your current working-tree state so nothing is lost — explicit paths for the loader/3d/bake/cli files YOU touched (NOT git add -A; there are ~360 set-aside files in the tree). Honest message, e.g. "wip(platmod): 2D tile placeholder + cube-behind-flag — real 3D world render NOT done yet". Then do the fix.

Stay in your own context — no Task tool, no subagents (a subagent here hides exactly the work that keeps going wrong). tools/rjit only. No reset/revert. If you cross ~55% context mid-task, /hand-over rather than degrade.
